content.title: Jonathan Young Survivor 50 Preseason Interview
content.text: Today, Mike Bloom sits down with returning castaway Jonathan Young in this preseason interview. Mike and Jonathan run through the new dynamics, threats, and wild personalities returning for Survivor’s milestone season. Survivor 50 is back with even more challenge beasts, big targets, and tough choices for returning players like Jonathan, who’s ready to adapt and outplay after learning some hard lessons from season 42. Jonathan shares his game plan, having gleaned wisdom from legends like Boston Rob and his experiences on Survivor 42 and in life since. He reveals his thoughts on being a “provider,” hiding behind bigger threats, and struggling with the “new school” versus “old school” divide. Jonathan and Mike play “Friend or Foe,” breaking down the cast, with Jonathan’s honest, sometimes hilarious reads on players like Ozzy, Colby, Stephenie, and Cirie, plus what makes new faces from season 49 so unpredictable. – Jonathan explains how advice from Boston Rob is shaping his approach for Survivor 50 – A candid breakdown of which returning players Jonathan sees as allies (and which as threats) – Insights into the “old school vs. new school” dynamic and how it impacts tribal trust – Jonathan’s take on the physical and mental prep needed for the tougher, food-deprivation seasons – A funny moment as Jonathan draws a blank on a fellow player’s name only to realize they’ve been smiling at each other all week Jonathan’s ready to “stay out of sight, out of mind”—but will he be able to fly under the radar when surrounded by Survivor icons and big-game hunters? With alliances ready to shift and targets everywhere, which strategy will take him deeper: relying on challenge prowess or adapting to unpredictable new-school players? Join him as he interviews each of the returning players leading up to the Survivor 50 premiere on February 25th.
